name: Biodiversity Grant Scheme
summary: Portsmouth Water grants of up to GBP 10,000 for constituted not-for-profit conservation groups and local authority countryside teams improving habitat around its land, including habitat creation, invasive species control, surveys and equipment.

amount.note: Small grants up to £1,000 and large grants of £1,000 to £10,000

reporting: A short final report with before and after photos, accounts and how objectives were met, due within one month of project completion, which releases the final 15% of the grant.

status.quote: The application period for the 2026/27 grant scheme is now closed and will open again in Spring 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Constituted not for profit conservation groups with an associated bank account into which funds can be transferred.

geography.quote: Is the project in the Portsmouth Water operational area?

access.quote: Applications will be open from 13 April to 18 May 2026.

window.quote: The application period for the 2026/27 grant scheme is now closed and will open again in Spring 2027.

amount.quote: We are offering a large grant scheme for single payments between £1,000 and £10,000 for projects

pool.quote: The biodiversity fund is to the value of £50,000 for 2026-2027.

reporting.quote: The production of a short final report including before and after photos, accounts and how objectives have been met to be submitted within 1 month of project completion.
